subject: NEW SUPPLYER
text:
Hello, I am Edgar from Cronte Technology. I would like to review your
catalog to see if your products meet our needs. We like long-term business.

Please send me your catalog and a price list with the MOQ that includes the
best-selling products in Latin America.

We are looking for a manufacturer of the following products:
- Wi-Fi radio link antennas
- Regular and high-power Wi-Fi routers
- Mesh Wi-Fi routers
- Wi-Fi access points
- Wi-Fi range extender repeaters
- Switches

You can check our website: www.cronte.net. We are an important company with
physical presence in the major cities of my country.

I look forward to hearing from you.
Best regards
Eng. Edgar Correa
WhatsApp: +593 98 756 6811
WeChat: +1 5054049006
email: depcompras@cronte.net
